title: Omio scales travel product development using OpenAI models
summary: Omio, a multimodal travel platform operating across 47 countries with 3,000+ transportation providers, integrates OpenAI models throughout its engineering operations to accelerate travel product development and booking interface creation. The company's CTO emphasizes complete process redesign rather than superficial technology additions.
problem_solved: Accelerates the development and launch of travel products and booking interfaces for a global-scale travel platform serving thousands of transportation providers.
why_valuable: Demonstrates how large-scale enterprises can leverage AI to fundamentally transform product development workflows rather than just adding technology to legacy processes.
